question: What was the prime target of the first five-year plan of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Development of agriculture.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• First Five year Plan

 
 
• 1st five-year plan was for the period of 1951 to 1956.
 
• The prime target of the first five-year plan of India was the Development of agriculture.
 
• The target Growth was 2.1 % and the Actual Growth was 3.6 %.
 
• It was based on Harrod-Domar.
 
• The influx of refugees, severe food shortage & mounting inflation confronted the country at the onset of the first five-year plan.
